description: Eclipse privacy-first browser agent — extension (Chrome MV3). Sprint 2: vision + redaction + gate.
name: eclipse-extension

scripts.build: esbuild src/offscreen.ts src/content.ts src/background.ts src/popup.ts --bundle --format=esm --outdir=dist --sourcemap && mkdir -p dist/ort-wasm && cp node_modules/onnxruntime-web/dist/*.wasm dist/ort-wasm/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.pretest: rm -rf tests-dist && esbuild src/vision/*.ts src/executor.ts src/vault.ts src/execute-options.ts src/monitor.ts src/notifications.ts src/background.ts src/popup.ts src/missions.ts src/realtime.ts --outdir=tests-dist --format=esm --log-level=warning
